title: LE4Mob: Towards Inductive, Distance-Aware and General-Purpose Location Embedding for Human Mobility Modelling
abstract: arXiv:2609.22117v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Location representations provide mobility models with fundamental information about the spatial position, functional characteristics, and relationships of places. However, existing embeddings are often dependent on mobility observations, unable to represent unseen locations, and weakly constrained to retain geographic distance. This limits their reuse across datasets and mobility tasks. To address these limitations, we propose LE4Mob, an inductive, distance-aware, and geography-derived location embedding framework for mobility modelling. LE4Mob extends contrastive language-location pre-training while introducing a distance-aware regularisation objective that encourages the embedding space to preserve spatial relationships. Pre-trained from geographic context, LE4Mob can encode rich spatial-semantic information and generate embeddings for unseen locations inductively. translated_title: LE4Mob：面向人类移动性建模的归纳式、距离感知且通用的位置嵌入
translated_abstract: 位置表示为移动性模型提供了关于地点空间位置、功能特征及其相互关系的基础信息。然而，现有的嵌入方法通常依赖于移动性观测数据，无法表示未见过的位置，且对保留地理距离的约束较弱，这限制了它们在不同数据集和移动性任务之间的复用。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了LE4Mob，一个用于移动性建模的归纳式、距离感知且源自地理信息的位置嵌入框架。LE4Mob在对比性语言-位置预训练的基础上进行了扩展，并引入了距离感知的正则化目标，促使嵌入空间保留空间关系。通过从地理上下文进行预训练，LE4Mob能够编码丰富的空间语义信息，并以归纳的方式为未见过的位置生成嵌入。其独立于下游移动性任务监督的特性，也使其...
tldr: 提出了LE4Mob框架，将对比性语言-位置预训练与距离感知正则化相结合，实现了不依赖下游任务监督的归纳式位置嵌入，可为未见过的位置生成嵌入并在不同数据集和移动性任务间复用。
